camel_example: aliyun sas DescribeStrategy --region cn-hangzhou --CustomType custom --SourceIp '1.2.X.X' --Lang zh --StrategyIds 8164248
kebab_example: aliyun sas describe-strategy --source-ip 1.2.X.X --lang zh --strategy-ids 8164248 --custom-type custom --api-version 2018-12-03 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeStrategy

parameters.help_en: The source IP address of the request
parameters.name: source_ip

parameters.help_en:
The language of the request and response messages. Default value: zh. Valid values:

zh: Chinese.
en: English
parameters.help_zh:
设置请求和接收消息的语言类型，默认为zh。取值：

zh：中文
en：英文
parameters.name: lang

parameters.help_en: The IDs of the policies to query. Separate multiple IDs with commas (,)
parameters.help_zh: 要查询的策略的ID。多个ID之间使用半角逗号（,）隔开
parameters.name: strategy_ids

parameters.help_en:
The type of the policies to query. Valid values:

common: standard policy
custom: custom policy
parameters.help_zh:
要查询的策略的类型。取值：

common：标准策略
custom：自定义策略
parameters.name: custom_type

schema.description_en: The baseline check policy information returned
schema.description_zh: 基线检查策略返回信息

RequestId.description_en: The ID of the request. The ID is a unique identifier generated by Alibaba Cloud for the request. You can use the ID to troubleshoot and locate issues
RequestId.description_zh: 本次调用请求的ID，是由阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符，可用于排查和定位问题

Strategies.description_en: The collection of detailed information about the policies

items.description_en: The detailed information about a policy

ConfigTargets.description_en: The collection of information about the assets to which the policy applies
ConfigTargets.description_zh: 策略生效资产的信息集合

items.description_en: The information about an asset to which the policy applies

Flag.description_en:
Specifies whether the policy applies to the asset group. Valid values:

add: the policy applies to the asset group.
del: the policy does not apply to the asset group
Flag.description_zh:
策略是否对该资产分组生效。取值：

add：对该资产分组生效
del：不对该资产分组生效

Target.description_en: The group ID or UUID of the asset to which the policy applies
Target.description_zh: 策略生效的资产的分组ID或者UUID

TargetType.description_en:
The method used to add the assets to which the policy applies. Valid values:

groupId: assets are added by group.
uuid: assets are added individually
TargetType.description_zh:
策略生效资产的添加方式。取值：

groupId：按照资产的分组添加。
uuid：按照单个资产添加

CustomType.description_en:
The type of the policy. Valid values:

common: standard policy
custom: custom policy
CustomType.description_zh:
策略的类型。取值：

common：标准策略
custom：自定义策略

CycleDays.description_en:
The interval of the baseline check. Valid values:

1: every 1 day
3: every 3 days
7: every 7 days
30: every 30 days
CycleDays.description_zh:
基线检查的周期。取值：

1：每隔1天
3：每隔3天
7：每隔7天
30：每隔30天

CycleStartTime.description_en:
The start time of the baseline check. Valid values:

0: the baseline check starts between 00:00 and 06:00.
6: the baseline check starts between 06:00 and 12:00.
12: the baseline check starts between 12:00 and 18:00.
18: the baseline check starts between 18:00 and 24:00
CycleStartTime.description_zh:
基线检查开始的时间。取值：

0：表示基线检查开始的时间为0:00~6:00
6：表示基线检查开始的时间为6:00~12:00
12：表示基线检查开始的时间为12:00~18:00
18：表示基线检查开始的时间为18:00~24:00

EcsCount.description_en: The number of assets to which the policy applies
EcsCount.description_zh: 策略生效的资产的数量

EndTime.description_en: The end time of the baseline check policy execution. The value is in the HH:mm:ss format
EndTime.description_zh: 基线检查策略执行结束时间。格式为 HH:mm:ss

ExecStatus.description_en:
The execution status of the baseline check policy. Valid values:

1: not executed
2: executing
ExecStatus.description_zh:
基线检查策略的执行状态。取值：

1：未执行
2：执行中

ExecutionType.description_en:
The trigger method of the baseline scan. Valid values:

Schedule: triggered by a scheduled task.
Manual: triggered manually
ExecutionType.description_zh:
基线扫描的触发方式。取值：

Schedule：周期性配置任务触发
Manual：手动触发

PassRate.description_en: The proportion of baselines with risks detected during the execution of the baseline check policy
PassRate.description_zh: 执行基线检查策略发现的存在风险的基线的占比

Percent.description_en: The progress of the baseline check. This parameter is returned only for baselines where ExecStatus is set to 2
Percent.description_zh: 检查中基线的检查进度，仅ExecStatus = 2的基线会返回该参数

ProcessRate.description_en: The number of assets on which the baseline check is complete
ProcessRate.description_zh: 已完成基线检查的资产的数量

RiskCount.description_en: The number of baseline check items included in the policy
RiskCount.description_zh: 策略包含的基线检查项的数量

StartTime.description_en: The start time of the baseline check policy execution. The value is in the HH:mm:ss format
StartTime.description_zh: 基线检查策略执行开始时间。格式为 HH:mm:ss

Type.description_en:
The source type of the policy. Valid values:

1: a built-in policy, which is the default baseline check policy that Security Center executes.
2: a user-added policy, including standard policies and custom policies created by users
Type.description_zh:
策略的来源类型。取值：

1：系统自带的策略，即云安全中心默认执行的基线检查策略。
2：用户添加的策略，包括用户自定义创建的标准策略和自定义策略

UserModifyTime.description_en: The last modification time of the baseline check policy. The value is in the YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm:ss format
UserModifyTime.description_zh: 基线检测策略的上次修改时间，格式为 YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm:ss
